messages.subject: Merry xlsx
messages.body_plain:
All,

On the off chance that I am not the only person who didn't know about this...

I just discovered the xlsx library, which, thus far, seems to be doing a pretty nice job importing xls and xlsx spreadhseets directly into R (on a Mac).  Have noticed a few small issues with dates (1904 vs 1900 systems and some rounding discrepancies), and that it is a bit slow, but otherwise it seems to work a treat!

Ben

messages.subject: accessing netCDF files through a wms/http or other servers
messages.subject_clean: accessing netCDF files through a wms/http or other servers
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I am trying to access .nc and .vrt files stored on an external server. There is access connections through OPENDAP, HTTP Server, WCS, WMS, NetcdfSubset, NCML, UDDC and ISO.

However, I am having trouble finding packages that deal with the downloading through R.

If anyone has any experience with netcdf files or could point me to a few packages I would greatly appreciate it!

Cheers

Gen
